a.lede: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explained why he offered buyouts to 60,000 of his employees in October, essentially urging them to voluntarily quit, rather than reducing the workforce via another massive layoff. The short answer is AI, but not in the way you might expect.
a.title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explains why he asked 60K employees to quit

b.lede: Microsoft's CEO says AI agents could disrupt advertising-driven business models, forcing companies like Amazon to rethink how they compete for customers.
b.title: Satya Nadella predicts AI agents will reshuffle the economics of the web
